summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Watchlist persistence  **What I did:** read-only trace of the whole path (no edits) — `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `useAuth.tsx`/`App.tsx` → `server.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` → `db/index.ts`.  **What I found:** the current code, as written, looks correct end-to-end: - Client sends `credentials: "include"` on every request; no localStorage/sessionStorage is used anywhere near watchlists (only theme uses localStorage). - `App.tsx` gates the entire app behind `useAuth()` — there
